title: Continuation and missing work
summary: Advance dev4 by executing current-baseline tests, completing the HTTPS-side upgrade wrapper, qualifying live wss, and binding production entropy while preserving socket, HTTPS, crypto and identity authority boundaries.
invariants: Execute test_websocket_contract.rex and test_server_access.rex under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196.
Execute test_platform_crypto.rex against exact Crypto v0.8.3 plus crypto.auth/0.1.
Execute independent COTS client and server interoperability against Socket Provider dev16 before promotion.
Implement the narrow upgrade-stream counterpart in the owning ooRexx HTTPS server; do not expose raw transport internals.
Qualify Rasen Falcon/Wire wss through the owned HTTPS path with the HTTPS worker/TLS-generation lease retained for the upgraded connection.
Bind WebSocketEntropySource to the estate production randomness authority and qualify exact nonce/mask delivery.
Do not add another RNG, shell-command crypto or WebSocket-owned OpenSSL/TLS binding.
Keep LDAP/application identity and authorization above the WebSocket framing boundary.
Add extension negotiation only through explicit extension objects and fail closed for unsupported negotiated extensions.
Treat RFC 8441 and RFC 9220 as explicit WebSocket-over-HTTP/2 and WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 compositions.
Use Rasen Falcon componentId websocket-access for all coordination from this lane.
